description_en: Queries the preparation and deployment progress of the current submission for a custom image by preparation task ID
description_zh: 通过准备任务 ID 查询自定义镜像本次提交的准备与部署进度
kebab_example: aliyun agentcore get-custom-agent-image-preparation --workspace-id ws-example --preparation-id agent-example:1 --region cn-hangzhou
name: GetCustomAgentImagePreparation

parameters.help_en: The Console image preparation task ID
parameters.help_zh: Console 镜像准备任务 ID
parameters.name: preparation_id

data.description_en: The preparation query result. For the asynchronous execution status, see phase
data.description_zh: 准备查询结果；异步执行状态看 phase

error.description_en: The error. This parameter is returned only when the task fails. Otherwise, the value is null
error.description_zh: 仅失败返回安全错误，其余为 null

code.description_en: The business error code for image preparation. It is used to identify the failure type. For the specific cause, see message
code.description_zh: 镜像准备的业务错误码；用于识别失败类型，具体原因见 message
code.title_en: 镜像准备的业务错误码；用于识别失败类型，具体原因见 message
code.title_zh: 镜像准备的业务错误码；用于识别失败类型，具体原因见 message

message.description_en: The specific cause of the failure. It may include underlying errors such as image not found, authentication failure, network timeout, or certificate verification error. Passwords, tokens, or authentication headers are not returned. If the underlying system does not provide a cause, a general description is returned
message.description_zh: 本次失败的具体原因，可包含底层返回的镜像不存在、认证失败、网络超时或证书校验错误；不返回密码、令牌或认证头。底层未提供原因时返回通用说明
message.example: tls: failed to verify certificate: x509: certificate signed by unknown authority
message.title_en: 本次失败的具体原因，可包含底层返回的镜像不存在、认证失败、网络超时或证书校验错误；不返回密码、令牌或认证头。底层未提供原因时返回通用说明
message.title_zh: 本次失败的具体原因，可包含底层返回的镜像不存在、认证失败、网络超时或证书校验错误；不返回密码、令牌或认证头。底层未提供原因时返回通用说明

error.title_en: 仅失败返回安全错误，其余为 null
error.title_zh: 仅失败返回安全错误，其余为 null

failedPhase.description_en: The phase where the failure occurred. This parameter is returned only when the phase is FAILED. Otherwise, the value is null
failedPhase.description_zh: 仅 FAILED 返回失败阶段，其余为 null
failedPhase.title_en: 仅 FAILED 返回失败阶段，其余为 null
failedPhase.title_zh: 仅 FAILED 返回失败阶段，其余为 null

phase.description_en: The current phase. Only SUCCEEDED indicates that the target version is deployed successfully
phase.description_zh: 当前阶段；只有 SUCCEEDED 表示本次目标版本部署成功
phase.title_en: 当前阶段；只有 SUCCEEDED 表示本次目标版本部署成功
phase.title_zh: 当前阶段；只有 SUCCEEDED 表示本次目标版本部署成功

preparationId.description_en: The Console task ID for the current submission
preparationId.description_zh: Console 本次提交任务 ID
preparationId.title_en: Console 本次提交任务 ID
preparationId.title_zh: Console 本次提交任务 ID

data.title_en: 准备查询结果；异步执行状态看 phase
